items.source_en:
It's that time of year again, and here I am. Still carrying your ring, still with the Trandoshans, still a goddamn coward.

Why'd you have to stand up for me that night? I was the one that screwed up. I was the one being stupid, and you damn well knew it.

I didn't want to kill you... but they left me no choice... and you knew. You knew I'd do it to save myself.

And me? I didn't even have the courage to at least look at you when I pulled the trigger.

I should have let Bog have you. I knew how much he loved you. Hell, you even loved him. I just... didn't care.

I figured the moment you had each other, I'd be alone... Heh. And look at me now.
items.legacy_ko:
또 그날이 왔네. 난 여전히 네 반지를 끼고, 여전히 트란도샨들과 함께하며, 여전히 빌어먹을 겁쟁이로 살고 있어.

그날 밤 왜 날 감싸준 거야? 망친 건 나였어. 멍청하게 굴었던 것도 나였고, 너도 그걸 잘 알고 있었잖아.

널 죽이고 싶진 않았어... 하지만 그들이 선택의 여지를 주지 않았지... 그리고 넌 알고 있었어. 내가 살기 위해 널 죽일 거라는 걸.

난? 방아쇠를 당길 때 널 쳐다볼 용기조차 없었어.

차라리 보그에게 널 넘길걸 그랬어. 그가 널 얼마나 사랑했는지 알았잖아. 젠장, 너도 그를 사랑했지. 난 그냥... 상관없었어.

그날 밤 왜 날 감싸준 거야? 망친 건 나였어. 멍청하게 굴었던 것도 나였고, 너도 그걸 잘 알고 있었잖아.

널 죽이고 싶진 않았어... 하지만 그들이 선택의 여지를 주지 않았지... 그리고 넌 알고 있었어. 내가 살기 위해 널 죽일 거라는 걸.

난? 방아쇠를 당길 때 널 쳐다볼 용기조차 없었어.

차라리 보그에게 널 넘길걸 그랬어. 그가 널 얼마나 사랑했는지 알았잖아. 젠장, 너도 그를 사랑했지. 난 그냥... 상관없었어.

둘이 함께하는 순간 나만 혼자가 될 거라 생각했거든... 하. 지금 내 꼴을 봐.

locations.vanilla_source_en:
It's that time of year again, and here I am. Still carrying your ring, still with Ecliptic, still a goddamn coward.

Why'd you have to stand up for me that night? I was the one that screwed up. I was the one being stupid, and you damn well knew it.

I didn't want to kill you... but they left me no choice... and you knew. You knew I'd do it to save myself.

And me? I didn't even have the courage to at least look at you when I pulled the trigger.

I should have let Bog have you. I knew how much he loved you. Hell, you even loved him. I just... didn't care.

I figured the moment you had each other, I'd be alone... Heh. And look at me now.

items.source_en:
Dom,

Taleucema's choking. Three more families disappeared this month after customs flagged their cargo. The Imperials are using "trade violations" as an excuse to seize property and arrest anyone who looks at them wrong.

Your name came up in a network meeting. We're not looking for soldiers -- we're looking for people who know how to operate quietly, move supplies off the official channels, and won't fold when the stormtroopers start asking questions.
I know you've refused before. I know why. But when the Empire runs out of targets in Taleucema, they're going to expand their patrols. Your valley won't stay off their scopes forever.

Not asking you to pick up a blaster. Just asking you to think about where your supplies will come from when we're all gone.

Channel stays open.

—Rowan


Rowan,

We came here to bury the war. I won't dig it back up.

We'll find our own supply lines. Appreciate the offer.

—Dom

You may have left the war behind, but there's a new one coming, and you might not be able to bury this one. 

We'll keep the channel open anyway. Things are getting worse out here.

Stay safe.
—R.
items.legacy_ko:
돔,

탈레우세마가 숨이 막혀오고 있어. 세관이 화물을 문제 삼은 뒤로 이번 달에만 세 가족이 더 사라졌어. 제국군은 "무역 위반"을 구실로 재산을 압류하고 자기들을 이상하게 쳐다보는 사람은 누구든 체포하고 있어.

네트워크 회의에서 당신 이름이 나왔어. 우리는 군인을 찾는 게 아니야. 조용히 활동하고, 공식 채널 밖으로 물자를 옮길 줄 알며, 스톰트루퍼가 질문을 시작해도 굴복하지 않을 사람들을 찾고 있어.
이전에도 거절했다는 건 알아. 왜 그런지도 알고. 하지만 제국군이 탈레우세마에서 목표물을 다 처리하고 나면 순찰 범위를 넓힐 거야. 당신들의 계곡도 영원히 그들의 레이더를 피할 순 없어.
